subject: The secret mistake 92% of SoulPlan users make
preview_text: It's not about the dates you plan. It's about the 3 minutes you skip. The truth inside.
body_paragraphs: I was talking to a couple who used SoulPlan for months. They planned amazing dates. But they told me something was still missing. The spark between big dates felt dim. Then I asked them one question, and they went silent.

The magic isn't in the grand, weekly date night. It's in the tiny, daily connection. The couples who say the app 'improved their relationship' have a secret. They don't just plan. They connect. For 3 minutes a day. That's the habit loop. A tiny, consistent investment that builds an identity: 'We are a couple who prioritizes us.' It stops the routine from killing the romance before the next big date even happens.

This is why the Date History tracker is the most powerful, overlooked feature. It's not just a log. It's your relationship's highlight reel. Spending 3 minutes a day just looking at your past dates, laughing at the memories, and adding a quick note about how you felt... it reinforces why you do this. It turns planning from a chore into a celebration of your story.

Open SoulPlan right now. Don't plan a new date. Just open your Date History. Scroll through one memory. Add a one-sentence feeling next to it. That's the 3-minute routine. Do that this week. P.S. The couples who do this are 10x more likely to use the Surprise Date Planner... because they're constantly reminded why surprising each other matters.
